description: Leading AI laboratories outside the EU, observing the stagnation in openweight capability despite high closed-frontier advances, independently begin publishing detailed technical reports on alignment failures and containment breaches observed during training runs. These are framed as 'open safety contributions' and include red-team findings, model behavior under adversarial conditions, and partial architecture details intended to improve collective defensive capacity. The releases are limited to non-capability-enabling information but significantly boost public evaluation efforts and interpretability research.
